title: Connected Macro Studio source review
scope: Read-only review of the six connected Macro Studio integration/core files against the preserved connected-macro-studio-base snapshots.
reviewed_behaviors: Connected mutations require session-control and active permitted virtual users; recording is explicitly unavailable because input attribution is not implemented.
Clip packet devices are rebound to the selected virtual seat; edit/reset/play paths validate candidates before replacing lane state.

Playback has a distinct agent owner keyed by client, user, pinned HWND and PID; owner-scoped claims, queues, cancellation, completion and disconnect/revocation cleanup preserve other actors and manual claims.

Each playback action is rechecked at delivery, including replication; source recipient checks pin the source user to the selected app PID while allowing child HWNDs in that same process, and destination scope remains policy-checked.

Macro Studio nested acknowledgements reach MCP and GUI state; external acknowledgements merge clip state without consuming an outstanding local edit or its draft. The external-update status test now uses the authoring state with agent_client unset.
validation_limits: This is source review only. The reviewer did not run Cargo checks or native applications.
No native acceptance or broader product-parity claim is made.
